rate_offered.notes: Nominal annual rate before tax printed '1.00%'. Row '256 - רימונים- חודשי פריים לשנה': period '12 חודשים', rate type 'משתנה', linkage 'אין', break 'לא ניתן לשבור', automatic renewal 'לא מתחדש', number of renewals 'לא מתחדש', exit points 'יש' 'תחנת יציאה ראשונה לאחר 1 חודשים ולאחר מכן תחנת יציאה מדי 1 חודשים', anchor 'P=4.75%', deposit options 'כיצד להפקיד'. Amount tiers merged into this record (each as printed): '50000' / 'P-3.75%' / '1.00%' / common '' / effective '1.00%'; '100000' / 'P-3.75%' / '1.00%' / common '' / effective '1.00%'; '250000' / 'P-3.75%' / '1.00%' / common '' / effective '1.00%'; '1000000' / 'P-3.75%' / '1.00%' / common '' / effective '1.00%'; '1000000<' / 'P-3.75%' / '1.00%' / common '' / effective '1.00%'. Read 2026-11-14 from the table the page loads (https://www.mizrahi-tefahot.co.il/umbraco/surface/NabatDeposits/GetNabatDeposits?depositType=fixed&pageIndex=1&itemsPerPage=500&currencyCode=), 'כל המידע המוצג נכון לתאריך ושעה' 13/11/2026 08:30:53; amount tiers are printed as upper bounds under 'טווח סכום להפקדה (לא כולל)'. The read of 2026-11-09 printed '1.01%' and 'P-3.74%' on every tier.

tax_bucket.notes: Unlinked shekel deposit: interest taxed at 15% of the nominal interest (TXI-03); 'linked' means CPI or exchange rate, so an unlinked or prime-linked shekel deposit is in this bucket (TXI-04); the bank withholds 15% (TXI-08). Copied from the rule base (TXI-03's source, read 2026-10-25), not re-read today.
